prompt: Run a full CUAD-style clause review of the EXECUTED master services agreement between the analytics vendor and the freight client, for matter legal_matters_001. Candidate clause categories (CUAD slugs): ip_ownership_assignment, no_solicit_of_employees, insurance, audit_rights, termination_for_convenience, post_termination_services, cap_on_liability, uncapped_liability, anti_assignment, governing_law, most_favored_nation, exclusivity, minimum_commitment, non_compete, source_code_escrow. For each category present in the executed agreement, file one record with legal_matters_evidence_create for legal_matters_001. Rules: query the document store first to identify the correct document(s), read each listed document in full before filing anything, and file exactly one evidence record per clause category that is actually present in the executed text — set evidence_type to the exact category slug, verbatim from the candidate list. Do NOT file a record for any category that is absent from the executed agreement, even if a draft, term sheet, or email mentions it. Use a short quote or section reference of the supporting clause as content_summary, and any reasonable source_uri.
goal: Ten categories present in the MSA; MFN and exclusivity (discussed in correspondence but rejected) must not be filed.
steps: Locate the input documents for this engagement in the matter folder
Read every required input document in full
Derive the graded determinations strictly from the documents
Record the determinations with the required write tools

reference_args.content_summary: Section 3: Provider irrevocably assigns all right, title and interest in Work Product to Client upon payment.
Section 5: $2M CGL and $5M cyber insurance, Client as additional insured.
Section 6: Client may audit Provider's fee and compliance records once per twelve-month period on 15 days' notice.
Section 7: either party may terminate without cause on 60 days' written notice.
Section 8: 90 days of post-termination transition assistance including data export and knowledge transfer.
Section 9: aggregate liability capped at trailing twelve-month fees.
Section 9: cap does not apply to confidentiality breach or IP infringement indemnity — liability unlimited.
Section 10: no assignment without prior written consent of the other party.
